tools.name: list_open_settlements
tools.description: List currently-open U.S. class-action settlements tracked by ClaimFinder — name, claim deadline, a plain-language summary, and who may qualify. Use this to tell a user which settlements they can still file a claim for. Informational only, not legal advice.

tools.name: search_settlements
tools.description: Search ClaimFinder's open class-action settlements by keyword (company, data breach, product, or who-qualifies text). Returns matching settlements with name, deadline, summary, and official-site link so an assistant can cite the right one. Informational only, not legal advice.

tools.name: get_settlement
tools.description: Get one ClaimFinder settlement's full record by slug (from list/search results): name, summary, claim deadline, who may qualify, the official settlement site, and the ClaimFinder detail page. Always direct users to confirm eligibility and file on the official site. Informational only, not legal advi
